label: Glass relight (liquid glass over a photo)
description: iOS-26 LIQUID GLASS over a full-frame photo, one glass object changing shape the whole way (the relay 'Glass' beat). Beats: the photo full-frame from `at`; a GLASS WORD pops in letter by letter (word_at; each letter a glass glyph refracting the photo, rim-lit); it MELTS into one droplet (melt_at, goo) that falls to the bottom centre and STRETCHES into a glass TOOLBAR pill (toolbar_at) whose line icons pop in on a spring; the cursor likes the heart (like_at) and clicks ADJUST (click_at); the toolbar morphs into a glass SLIDER panel (slider_at: label + value 0..100 + track + glass knob); the cursor DRAGS the knob to 100 (drag_at -> drag_end) and the photo RELIGHTS in step (image -> image_after, two aligned shots; without image_after a warm golden-hour grade + a sun glow at `sun`); the knob turns into a round glass LENS while held (lens_at), the panel is drawn into it, it LIFTS into a glass ORB (0.28 of the frame) at the upper middle and next_image opens inside it as a circle (orb_at); the orb EXPANDS to full frame (expand_at, 0.35 s). The last frame is next_image full-frame (object-fit cover over the component box) -- identical to a plain full-frame photo, so the next scene starts on it. A camera push (screen-studio) onto the toolbar and back out is built in (camera:false turns it off). Every glass shape carries its own copy of the photo behind it: rim refraction with chromatic edges, frost, tint, rim light, soft shadow. All times are scene seconds; defaults are relative to `at`. Full-frame box. Example: {"image":"/assets/arch_day.jpg","image_after":"/assets/arch_golden.jpg","next_image":"/assets/astronaut.jpg","word":"relight.","slider_label":"Golden hour","at":0,"cursor_from":[0.72,0.5],"cursor_to":[0.8,0.74]}.

image_after.label: The SAME shot relit (golden hour), aligned with image -- the drag crossfades to it (reads as the light changing)

sun.label: Where the sun glow sits for the fallback grade (no image_after), fractions of the frame

next_image.label: The photo the orb carries into the next beat; it ends full-frame

word_x.label: Word centre, fraction of the frame width (default 0.36)

word_y.label: Word centre, fraction of the frame height (default 0.26)

word_size.label: Word font size, fraction of the frame (default 0.13)

icons.label: Toolbar icons, left to right (1.5px line icons)

accent.label: Colour of the clicked adjust icon (default iOS orange #ff9f0a)

toolbar_y.label: Toolbar centre, fraction of the frame height (default 0.9)

lens_size.label: Lens diameter, fraction of the frame (default 0.2)

orb_size.label: Orb diameter, fraction of the frame (default 0.28)

orb_x.label: Orb centre x, fraction of the frame (default 0.5)

orb_y.label: Orb centre y, fraction of the frame (default 0.36)

at.label: Start (s); every default time below is relative to it (default 0)

word_at.label: The glass word pops in, one letter per 0.05 s (default at+0.25)

melt_at.label: The word melts into one droplet, which falls (default at+1.0)

toolbar_at.label: The droplet stretches into the toolbar; icons pop one per 0.08 s (default at+1.3)

like_at.label: The cursor taps the heart (default click_at-0.3)

slider_at.label: The toolbar morphs into the slider panel (default at+2.5)

drag_at.label: The cursor grabs the knob at 0 (default at+2.75)

drag_end.label: The knob reaches 100; the photo is fully relit (default at+4.0)

lens_at.label: The held knob becomes a glass lens (default at+4.25)

orb_at.label: The lens lifts into the orb; next_image opens inside it (default at+4.5)

expand_at.label: The orb expands to full frame (default at+4.9)

camera.label: Screen-studio push onto the toolbar and back out (default true)

cursor_from.label: Where the cursor starts, [x, y] fractions of the frame (hand-on from the previous piece)

cursor_to.label: Where the cursor ends, [x, y] fractions of the frame (hand-off to the next piece)
